name: player_update_chase_camera_from_input
description: Player::UpdateChaseCameraFromInput applies third-person chase camera input, damping, obstruction probes, and camera node updates.
known_limits: Binary Ninja disassembly/HLIL for 0x405040 validates fastcall ECX=saveState, player/master data loads, cursor/steering mode branches, optional Mouse_GetStateSnapshotPtr copy, joystick/cursor/mouse yaw accumulation into thirdPersonYawOffset, low-speed elevation input into cameraElevationOffset, projectile-speed cameraUdSwing clamp, cameraDirFlat smoothing through zMath::Vec3LerpNormalize, g_Player_CameraHeadingDotAbs update, thirdPersonYawOffset Y rotation, cameraTargetDistance damping with g_Player_CameraElastic, track/non-track thirdPersonPositionYOffset damping, cameraPos/focusPos construction, sub-only AdjustSubCameraFocusForObstruction, normalized cameraDirNext, AdjustThirdPersonCameraBySideProbes, gwCameraSetTarget/gwCameraSetPosition, and cached cameraTarget/cameraDir writes.

The native smoke verifies a no-input, no-obstruction chase-camera update through the real camera setters and DI probe helpers, including camera target, camera position angles, normalized cameraDirNext, root flag restoration, and stop-after-first-hit reset.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x405040 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player camera/source-cluster pass.
